_comment: E4 scaled compound_scenario_v2 on 60 machines (12 per type): 2132 jobs, ~15855s, 17 phases. Same regimes as the 15-machine scenario at the same per-machine load: 4 parallel single-machine bottleneck lane(s) Weld[1, 2, 3, 4], a 8-machine standoff/speed-trap pool Weld[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]; quiet, burst and starvation load scaled with capacity (x4.00). At 15 machines identical to the original.
name: e4_compound_v2_m60
